description: This file defines the ResourceServer class within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 middleware. It handles OAuth2 token validation for incoming HTTP requests, manages user authentication, and ensures security for protected routes through the PSR-7 interface. It also defines exemption routes for open access.

classes.name: ResourceServer
classes.description: Middleware class for OAuth2 resource server, manages token validation and user session setting for API requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the ResourceServer middleware with an OAuthResourceServer instance.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that validates OAuth tokens unless the route is exempt, sets the global user, and calls the next middleware.

methods.name: setCurrentUserGlobal
methods.description: Sets the global $current_user variable after validating the user status.

methods.name: getUserFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the user associated with the OAuth token, falls back to client assigned user if necessary.
